finding: Estimates stocks of sovereign government obligations affected by default or debt distress; annual totals include amounts affected during the year.
limitation: Not a simple event register; exposure is not equivalent to realised creditor loss.

finding: Records monthly debt default and restructuring events between governments and private creditors involving local-law instruments; severity fields include amount, restructuring terms and reported NPV loss.
limitation: The source construct is instrument-level and does not establish payment-default proof for every record.

finding: Records restructuring processes involving governments and foreign private creditors.
limitation: Not a comprehensive census of sovereign defaults or all restructuring types.

finding: Country-year observations of debt obligations affected; repeated annual observations may relate to the same underlying debt.
limitation: 158 positive European country-year observations in the current extract across seven countries are not 158 independent default events.

finding: Instrument-level records, with an episode-level aggregate for the two Greek PSI instruments in the current severity output.
limitation: The current severity output contains two Greek PSI instruments and one episode, not a complete 20-country severity sample.

finding: Individual restructuring-process cases; multiple cases may occur for one country.
limitation: 197 main-sheet records were observed against 196 cases stated in the README.

finding: Annual observations; amounts cover sovereigns in default at any point during the year.
limitation: Does not establish a consistent year-end reference-date balance; do not sum annual values as cumulative losses.

finding: Monthly event records with start and end dates, sometimes recorded only at year precision.
limitation: Do not treat year-only dates as exact monthly chronology.

finding: Process chronology with start, end, announcement and default-date fields; several dates are missing or imprecise.
limitation: the source-wide audit identified 60 missing default dates and 41 imprecise start-date flags.

finding: Annual country-year precision.
limitation: Cannot establish instrument-level event dates from annual observations alone.

finding: Exact dates or year-only dates, depending on source record.
limitation: Temporal matching must preserve date precision; year overlap is contextual, not exact event identity.

finding: Dates may be exact, missing or imprecise; some start dates are estimated.
limitation: the source-wide audit identified 41 imprecise starts, 60 missing default dates and two chronology inversions.

finding: Default amounts are expressed in nominal US dollars.
limitation: Nominal USD is affected by inflation and exchange-rate movements; component coverage is incomplete.

finding: Instrument amounts are reported in million US dollars; NPV loss values are stored as decimal fractions despite the percentage column label.
limitation: Multiply raw NPV fractions by 100 for percentage expression; do not silently rescale stored source values.

finding: The source is a restructuring-process database; no common exposure currency or comparable monetary unit is established by the audited fields.
limitation: Do not manufacture a monetary comparison from process records.

finding: Nominal affected-debt exposure; domestic arrears may be derived from reported flows and stock information.
limitation: Not a real-value measure, year-end stock convention or realised creditor loss.

finding: Reported instrument amount and source-reported NPV loss; amount comparability and non-overlap of claims are not verified.
limitation: Weighted NPV is indicative only; cash-flow assumptions and unique claim basis are not independently established.

finding: Process chronology/classification rather than a common debt valuation measure.
limitation: Cannot compare process counts or flags with monetary exposure as if they were severity amounts.

finding: Includes official and private creditor categories, foreign-currency loans and bonds, local-currency debt and domestic arrears.
limitation: Not all categories have complete country-year coverage; domestic arrears have heterogeneous definitions.

finding: Private-creditor local-law instruments, with instrument labels including bank loans/commercial credit and bonds in the inspected records.
limitation: Do not assume comprehensive coverage of foreign-law debt or all creditor classes.

finding: Restructuring processes involving foreign private creditors.
limitation: Different creditor and legal scope from ESM local-law instrument coverage.

finding: Seven directly matched European peer countries have 158 positive observations in the current extract; historical predecessor labels require separate treatment.
limitation: No direct country-label match is not evidence of no default; predecessor observations are not allocated to successor states.

finding: The inspected workbook contains country-level records, but the current severity classification output contains only the Greek PSI episode.
limitation: No record in the inspected ESM dataset does not establish absence of default or restructuring.

finding: The audited 20-country peer extract contains 12 restructuring-process cases across Greece, Poland and Romania.
limitation: The other 17 peer countries have no main-sheet records; this is not evidence of no default.

finding: 158 positive observations across seven countries; creditor and instrument components are frequently missing, with no fully complete component observations in the composition audit.
limitation: Missing components must not be treated as zero; aggregate totals cannot be fully reconciled from incomplete components.

finding: 134 source rows; NPV loss is missing in 86 rows; face-value reduction and coupon change are each missing in 34; maturity change is missing in 17.
limitation: Missing NPV is not zero; missingness limits severity comparisons.

finding: Coverage is restricted to the source's restructuring-process universe; date and classification fields have missingness and imprecision.
limitation: No-record countries and missing dates must remain distinct from negative evidence.

finding: Operational default/distress includes interruption of scheduled debt service or renegotiation of contractual terms.
limitation: Broader than missed-payment-only definitions; restructuring and payment default are not interchangeable.

finding: Records local-law debt default and restructuring; binary fields indicate whether terms changed.
limitation: Binary face-value reduction is not a haircut percentage; source codebook interpretation must be retained.

finding: Retains strict-preemptive, weak-preemptive and post-default process flags.
limitation: Strict and weak flags overlap in 33 source-wide cases; preserve raw flags rather than force exclusive categories.

finding: A distinct exposure-oriented database with multiple underlying sources and estimates.
limitation: Underlying source overlap with other datasets has not been ruled out record by record.

finding: A distinct instrument-level dataset; source independence from every BoC–BoE or Kiel underlying input has not been established.
limitation: A separate database is not automatically independent corroboration.

finding: A distinct restructuring-process dataset; source independence from every ESM or BoC–BoE underlying source has not been established.
limitation: Do not infer independence from different database names.

finding: 158-observation extract reconciles exactly to its upstream source; duplicate country-year keys are zero; two total fields match exactly in the source-wide workbook across 8,749 observations.
limitation: Exact duplicate total fields are internal consistency, not independent validation; 2025/2026 methodology vintage alignment remains unresolved.

finding: Two Greek PSI instruments are traceable to source rows; source amounts and raw NPV values reconcile; 25 tests PASS, with one NOT_VERIFIABLE, one CALCULATED, one NOT_AVAILABLE and one UNRESOLVED outcome; zero FAIL.
limitation: Economic amount comparability is not verifiable; face-value haircut percentage is unavailable; weighted NPV is not independently validated as creditor loss.

finding: 197 unique main-sheet cases were observed; README reports 196; two chronology inversions and overlapping classification flags were found.
limitation: Internal audit checks source consistency and coverage, not independent historical event truth.

finding: Use country-year as a screening key only; require debt type, creditor, period and claim scope before linking to an instrument or process.
limitation: Annual exposure does not identify a unique restructuring process or instrument.

finding: Use country, instrument/legal scope and date interval; retain exact-date versus year-only provenance.
limitation: Year-range candidates are contextual only and cannot establish canonical event identity.

finding: Use country, restructuring-process dates, creditor scope and case-level chronology; retain raw flags and date precision.
limitation: A process case is not automatically the same claim or event as an ESM instrument record.

finding: Describe nominal affected-debt exposure by country-year and qualify observations using source coverage and reliability evidence.
limitation: Do not describe exposure as realised creditor loss or infer real economic severity from raw nominal USD.

finding: Describe source-reported instrument terms and NPV observations for traceable records, with missingness and valuation caveats.
limitation: Current severity output supports a Greek PSI case study, not a 20-country severity ranking.

finding: Describe restructuring-process chronology and source-coded process classifications within its foreign-private-creditor scope.
limitation: Do not use case counts as a comprehensive default census.

finding: Cannot establish realised creditor losses, independent default-event counts, complete creditor composition or country-level debt/GDP ratios from the audited extract.
limitation: Do not sum annual exposures, treat missing components as zero or use ordinal reliability scores as probabilities.

finding: Cannot establish unique aggregate creditor losses, percentage face-value haircuts from binary flags, or complete cross-country severity.
limitation: Amount arithmetic and weighted NPV do not prove non-overlapping claims or realised cash losses.

finding: Cannot establish a complete sovereign-default census, payment-default proof for every process, or monetary severity.
limitation: No record is not no default; a source-coded post-default flag is not independent payment-default verification.

finding: 2025 workbook/release note audited alongside a methodology document updated 2026-10-06; 16-entry evidence register and reproducible processed extracts exist.
limitation: Do not apply 2026-only methodological revisions retrospectively without the 2025 methodology version.

finding: Workbook inspected: esm_domestic_sovereign_defaults.xlsx; README and 2022 version sheet; severity and integrity outputs are reproducible from the local source.
limitation: Preserve source workbook vintage and raw decimal NPV encoding.

finding: Workbook inspected: kiel_monthly_sovereign_default_1970_2025.xlsx.xlsx; README, main dataset and ongoing-cases sheet.
limitation: README/main-sheet count discrepancy and date/classification anomalies must accompany reuse.
